"  \x1b[38;2;80;155;225malt/option+backspace\x1b[m  Delete previous word                                                        "
"  \x1b[38;2;80;155;225mctrl+w / alt+del\x1b[m      Delete previous / next word                                                 "
"  \x1b[38;2;80;155;225mctrl+k\x1b[m                Delete to end of line                                                       "
